themes.note: Frontmatter colours are the dark (default) values; colorMeta.<token>.light carries the light theme.

window-glow.note: Radial glow at the stage foot and in the hours panel. Sidecar only; not a frontmatter token.

window-spill.note: Linear spill across the counter pane. Sidecar only; not a frontmatter token.

streak.note: 1px line every 47px at 100deg on the fixed ground. Sidecar only; not a frontmatter token.

rain.note: Rain canvas stroke: an RGB triplet and an alpha. Sidecar only; not a frontmatter token.

selection.note: Text selection. Sidecar only; not a frontmatter token.

display.purpose: The coat headline only. 4.75rem under 1180px; clamp(3rem, 15vw, 4.5rem) under 960px. The closing coat uses 4.5rem / 0.95.

headline.purpose: Page titles; 4rem / 0.95 on product, order, visit and not found; 2.125rem (2.75rem for the large ones) under 960px.

title.purpose: Card names, legends, panel headings, totals (700 to 800).

body.purpose: Running text; ledes 1.0625 to 1.1875rem at 30rem to 64ch.

label.purpose: Uppercase, only for the roast scale ends.

figures.purpose: Prices, totals, quantities: tabular numerals, never wrapped.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Colour, background and border changes on buttons, links, fields, chips.

motion.name: ease-arrive
motion.purpose: Things arriving: the bag count bump (420ms) and the roast fill.

motion.name: roast-fill
motion.purpose: Roast steps scale up from the bottom when the scale enters view.

motion.name: rain
motion.value: canvas, at most 140 drops, 3 alpha layers, slant 0.2, 520 to 820 px/s
motion.purpose: Home first viewport only; stops off-screen and when hidden; one still frame under reduced motion.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce collapses every animation and transition.

narrative.northStar: The Oilskin Coat in the Rain
narrative.overview:
Sydvest is a Bergen roaster seen on a dark, wet evening. The ground is wet slate with a faint slanted rain streak; the brand is an oilskin-yellow coat, a flat material field that carries the headline and every primary action. Warmth comes from one other source only: window amber, the light of the counter seen from the street, used for what is "inside and warm" (the counter, its hours, the roast scale). Dark is the default whatever the system prefers; a considered light theme ("overcast noon") puts the same coat on fog grey with slate ink.

The system is square and plain. Everything is cut with 0 radius and 1px rules except the coat, which has one curved oilskin edge. One typeface, Schibsted Grotesk, does everything from a 96px heavy headline to tabular prices. Depth is tonal: slate steps up to raised slate, and the coat alone casts a soft shadow. Density is moderate: the home page is a sequence of distinct shapes (coat and shelf, gear split, lit window, four-column money rows, closing coat); the working pages (shop, product, bag, checkout, pay, order, the counter) are quiet two-column layouts with a surface side panel.

The build refuses the roaster default of kraft paper, stamps and cream, and it ships no photography: products are named, described in facts, and shown by their roast scale.
keyCharacteristics: Oilskin yellow as a material field, never a tint: flat, edged, with oil-ink text on it.
Window amber only for the counter, hours and roast fill; never on an action.
Square everywhere; one curved coat edge per coat.
One grotesk, heavy and tight at display sizes, tabular in figures.
Tonal slate layering with 1px rules; the coat is the only lifted thing.
Rain is ambient: a fixed slanted streak on the ground and a quiet canvas behind the home page's first viewport.

rules.name: The Coat Rule
rules.body: Oilskin fields and actions are opaque yellow, never a wash or a gradient; the one translucent oilskin is the text-selection highlight. On it, text is oil ink (`on-oilskin`); in the light theme every oilskin field carries a 1px ink edge (`oilskin-edge`).

rules.name: The Window Rule
rules.body: Amber means "inside, warm": the counter, its hours, the roast. No button, link, selection or price is amber.

rules.name: The Two Themes Rule
rules.body: Every colour is a token with a dark and a light value; no colour is written for one theme only. Dark is the default regardless of the system preference.

rules.name: The Tight Heavy Rule
rules.body: Display, headline and section titles are 800 with negative tracking (-0.015em base, -0.03em to -0.035em at headline and display) and `text-wrap: balance`. Body never goes below 400 or above 1.1875rem.

rules.name: The Honest Figures Rule
rules.body: Prices, totals, quantities and outputs use tabular numerals, never break across lines, and are set at 700 or 800.

rules.name: The One Hung Coat Rule
rules.body: Only the hero coat casts a shadow. Cards, panels and buttons stay flat; depth elsewhere is tone and rule.

dos: Do put every primary action and every selection on oilskin yellow, with oil-ink text and the `oilskin-edge` border.
Do use the ink button for the action inside a coat, and the ink-line button for its second action.
Do keep amber to the counter, its hours and the roast scale fill.
Do set every colour through a token that has both a dark and a light value; keep dark the default.
Do keep corners square; give a coat one curved corner (220px by 120px) and sit it flush on a page edge.
Do show prices in tabular figures at 700 or more, with their currency, and never wrapped.
Do mark a fact the shop has not settled (address, shipping) as italic muted text rather than inventing it.
Do honour `prefers-reduced-motion`: the rain stills and all transitions collapse.
donts: Don't put amber on a button, link, price or selection.
Don't round a button, card, input or panel.
Don't cast shadows from cards, panels or buttons; the hero coat is the only hung thing.
Don't use kraft paper, stamps, cream paper or stock photos of coffee bags.
Don't fade or gradient an oilskin field or action; translucent oilskin is for text selection only.
